messages:
maria: Need a fast decision: lock MVP cut by EOD. Proposal: 'Launchboard' MVP = chat core, embeddings export API, SSO pilot toggle. Defer: realtime dashboards, tenant CSV export, deep RBAC to v1.

devon: Agree on Launchboard slice. I'll surface infra/security risks for SSO toggle.

anya: I'll own the toggle gating + pilot checklist (whitelist, telemetry, onboarding call).

sam: UI action: hide dashboard nav and show "Coming in v1" card. I can ship a small placeholder + copy.

rafael: Perf note: pin to 13B-quant for predictable p99. Running quick sweeps now; will post numbers.

ops-bot: Reminder: "Launchboard MVP lock" sync tomorrow 09:30 in #all-hands.

maria: Launch acceptance: canary with 3 tenants for 72h, p99 < 700ms, smoke checklist pass, telemetry for errors/latency/token usage, documented rollback. If any fail, we reset milestone.

devon: Posting deps/owners table in #docs by 17:00.

anya: Sales has a Customer-Bravo pilot asking for tenant-export; we'll offer a manual CSV stopgap and include v1 ETA in GTM note.

sam: No objections to deferring dashboards.

rafael: Perf posted: p95=320ms p99=630ms on 13B-quant staging. Adding quality caveat to release notes.

maria: Consensus. I'll draft the decision doc and create milestone ticket after the sync. If you can't attend DM me. :thumbsup:
